description: This Dart source file implements a 'RealtimeService' class that manages WebSocket and SSE (Server-Sent Events) connections for real-time communication. It handles connection establishment, fallback reconnection strategies with exponential backoff, topic subscription management, message parsing, and JWT authorization headers.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Provides WebSocket and SSE connectivity, manages subscriptions, reconnections with exponential backoff, and message streaming for an attendance tracking app.

methods.name: RealtimeService.withTokenGetter
methods.description: Factory method for creating a RealtimeService instance with an external token getter.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates connection with WebSocket first; falls back to SSE if WebSocket fails. Manages reconnection logic.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a topic/channel by sending subscription commands over WebSocket or re-establishing SSE with updated topics.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a topic/channel, updating server-side subscription or triggering reconnection for SSE.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Terminates current WebSocket or SSE connection and stops reconnection attempts.
